presentation.par1: I am a passionate developer with over 4 years of experience, having started in web development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I was quickly drawn to the endless possibilities of development, especially the satisfaction of seeing tangible results from my work. This immediate feedback constantly pushes me to improve.
presentation.par2: My background has given me solid expertise in modern technologies such as React, NestJS, Prisma, AWS, Scaleway, and SQL. Working in large organizations in France has helped me develop a rigorous and structured approach to handling complex projects.
presentation.par3: Today, I’ve chosen to work as a freelancer because it allows me to manage projects from A to Z independently and take on technical challenges that match my ambitions.
presentation.par4: What I love most is helping people express themselves by turning their ideas into concrete and functional solutions. For me, every project is an opportunity to be creative and solve problems in innovative ways. My goal is always to deliver robust and well-thought-out products while ensuring an optimal user experience.

card1.sousTitre: Complete digital management platform for an independent restaurant.

description.intro: La Casa Altea is a restaurant with a full-stack platform built using React, NestJS, Prisma, SQL, and TypeScript. It provides autonomous, secure, and high-performance management of its operations.

fonctionnalites.f2: Advanced security: Token Guard, CORS, protection against cyberattacks.
fonctionnalites.f3: Admin dashboard to manage menus, availability, and orders.
fonctionnalites.f5: SEO & performance optimization for better visibility.

description.atoutsTitre: Why it's a benefit for the restaurant:

atouts.a2: Cost savings: reduced third-party platform commissions.
atouts.a3: Better control: access to strategic data in real-time.

description.conclusion: Thanks to this platform, La Casa Altea now has a powerful tool to manage its business with confidence, offer an optimal customer experience, and maximize profitability.

card2.sousTitre: Interactive platform for ecological awareness and sustainable engagement.

description.intro: Earthway is a web application under development, designed to raise awareness about protecting the planet. Created at the request of a committed client, it is built around four pillars: reforestation, coral reef protection, pollinator preservation, and promotion of eco-friendly innovations.

fonctionnalites.f1: Subscription system with multiple levels of engagement to support real-world environmental actions.
fonctionnalites.f2: Themed newsfeed: updates on reforestation, oceans, pollinators, and green innovations.
fonctionnalites.f3: Ethical marketplace: responsible products with affiliate links to sustainable partners.
fonctionnalites.f4: Community chat (coming in V2): a space for engaged users to connect.

objectifs.o2: Involve users in concrete actions at their level.
objectifs.o3: Facilitate access to eco-friendly alternatives through a carefully curated selection of products and services.
objectifs.o4: Build a loyal community around shared values and progressive commitment.

description.conclusion: Currently in the design phase, the interface is being prototyped on Adobe XD. This application is a freelance full-stack project with an ambitious vision: to offer citizens a concrete space to take action for the planet.

card3.sousTitre: Interactive showcase site for an artist specialized in tufting.

description.intro: Tuftissimo is a responsive showcase app designed for a freelance artist specializing in tufting. Developed with React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, it highlights her textile creations while facilitating client contact.

fonctionnalites.f1: Dynamic gallery of tufted rugs, mirrors, and wall decor.
fonctionnalites.f2: Direct Instagram link to discover her latest work and place orders.
fonctionnalites.f3: Built-in messaging system for personalized requests.
fonctionnalites.f4: Polished front-end with subtle animations and enhanced textile textures.
fonctionnalites.f5: Responsive design: smooth navigation on both mobile and desktop.
fonctionnalites.f6: Stylized contact form with validation and user feedback.

description.atoutsTitre: Why it's a benefit for Tuftissimo:

atouts.a1: Strong identity: showcases her unique artistic universe.
atouts.a2: Increased visibility: improved SEO via a dedicated site.
atouts.a3: Accessibility: her work is available online anytime.
atouts.a4: Direct relationship: simplifies exchanges with her clients.

description.conclusion: Tuftissimo allows the artist to present her work professionally while maintaining a human and creative connection with her clients. 🌟

card4.sousTitre: Redesign of a banking portal during a merger.

description.intro: As a full-stack developer at Société Générale, I participated in several internal projects, playing a key role in the redesign of a client portal during the merger with Crédit du Nord.

responsabilites.r1: Front-end reconstruction of the merged SG x Crédit du Nord site.
responsabilites.r2: Integration of video APIs for remote customer service.
responsabilites.r3: Automated testing (unit, integration) with coverage monitoring.
responsabilites.r4: Analytics tracking to follow user journeys.
responsabilites.r5: Performance testing to ensure smooth navigation.
responsabilites.r6: Accessibility improvements to comply with RGAA standards.
responsabilites.r7: Application maintenance and daily technical support.

description.conclusion: This position allowed me to work in an agile team, in a demanding banking environment, meeting high standards of quality and security, while contributing to large-scale solutions. 🏦

card5.sousTitre: Advanced Chrome extension to enhance Okta via REST API.

description.intro: As a full-stack developer, I contributed to the development of Rockstar, a Chrome extension that enhances the Okta user experience with advanced features like user CSV export and many other useful tools for administrators.

fonctionnalites.f1: Real-time feature enhancements on the Okta interface.
fonctionnalites.f2: CSV export of users, groups, and custom settings.
fonctionnalites.f3: Automated and secure Okta REST API requests.
fonctionnalites.f4: Full-stack development with business logic in the extension and back-end Node.

missions.m1: Developing new features based on user feedback.
missions.m2: Bug fixing and handling technical tickets.
missions.m3: Writing unit tests and automated testing scenarios.
missions.m4: Advanced use of Git for versioning and code reviews.

description.conclusion: This experience allowed me to master the full software development cycle, with strong exposure to REST APIs, collaborative work, and automation of repetitive tasks. 💼
